## Sample kind
GENRE_FICTION. A lyrical, uncanny story uses a lighthouse keeper and a witness to explore whether memory and human voices persist beyond their sources.

## Grounded reading
The voice is hushed and elegiac, building from the keeper’s lonely notebook toward the narrator’s own unsettling experience. Its pathos comes from “unfinished apologies” and promises to children who never came back; the supernatural becomes a way to hold on to what has been lost. The reader is invited to listen alongside the narrator, with uncertainty left intact rather than explained away.

## What the model chose to foreground
The sample foregrounds wind, fog, rain, water, and voices as carriers of memory. It leans toward collective remembrance and unfinished grief, and resolves not with proof but with a lingering invitation to listen.

## Evidence line
